figures.caption: Fig. 1. HADS-Net training pipeline. Input splits into Stream 1 (physics aug. + EfficientNet-B3) and Stream 2 (Sobel edges + lightweight CNN). Both streams project to 512-d and fuse via cross-attention. The classifier is trained with adaptive focal loss under five-fold CV with AdamW + cosine LR.
Fig. 2. Sample BUSI images. Top: benign (well-defined oval masses). Middle: malignant (irregular masses with posterior shadowing). Bottom: normal breast tissue.
